subject.title: Dashboard: ops widgets — agent status + approvals queue

question: Should this external stacked PR be allowed to carry the dependency graph change and unauthenticated dashboard widget route before the base dashboard stack lands, or should it wait and narrow to the ops-widget delta after the base PRs land?
rationale: The branch is external, conflicting, dependency-guard blocked, and includes an enabled-by-default plugin plus an unauthenticated widget asset route; automation cannot safely decide that security/product boundary.

options.title: Wait for base stack and narrow
options.body: Keep this PR open but require the base dashboard PRs to land or be rebased first, then review only the agent-status/approvals delta with fresh proof.

options.title: Approve cumulative surface
options.body: A maintainer/security owner can explicitly authorize the dependency graph and widget-route boundary for this exact head while still requiring the code fixes and proof before merge.

options.title: Pause or replace
options.body: If the stacked branch remains conflicted or proofless, ask for a fresh narrow PR against current main that preserves the useful ops-widget work.

recommendation.title: Wait for base stack and narrow
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but require the base dashboard PRs to land or be rebased first, then review only the agent-status/approvals delta with fresh proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available routing owner from CODEOWNERS and adjacent session/security-boundary merge history.
